notes.title: Travelers in Space Crack is now available on Steam
notes.notes:
You can embark on a journey of discovery through space crack.
I developed this PC game by myself, and I'm still working on it. Welcome to the steam forum to give me your suggestions and report bugs.
The game script has also been released, and everyone who is interested can modify it (including rules, data and art).
The game is run by a scripting engine. You can run the script directly without compiling it.
Thank you very much.

notes.title: Travelers in Space Crack is now available on Steam
notes.notes:
You can embark on a journey of exploration through the space cracks. 
This PC game is developed by me alone, and there will inevitably be some problems or bugs. Welcome to the steam forum to give me your suggestions and report the bugs. I will fix all bugs ASAP.
Game scrips are also released, everyone can modify it (include rules, data and art) if you are interested. 
Thank you very much.
